object	view	chat_access_profile_effective_revisions	chat_access_profile_effective_revisions	CREATE VIEW chat_access_profile_effective_revisions AS\nSELECT revision.*\nFROM chat_access_profiles profile\nJOIN chat_access_profile_revisions_numbered revision\n  ON revision.id = CASE\n      WHEN EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 FROM chat_access_profile_revisions named\n          WHERE named.id = profile.current_revision_id\n      ) THEN (\n          SELECT named.id FROM chat_access_profile_revisions named\n          WHERE named.id = profile.current_revision_id\n            AND named.access_profile_id = profile.id\n            AND named.maximum_folder_capability IS profile.current_maximum_folder_capability\n      )\n      ELSE (\n          SELECT newest.id FROM chat_access_profile_revisions newest\n          WHERE newest.access_profile_id = profile.id\n          ORDER BY newest.created_at DESC, newest.id DESC\n          LIMIT 1\n      )\n  END
object	view	chat_access_profile_revisions_numbered	chat_access_profile_revisions_numbered	CREATE VIEW chat_access_profile_revisions_numbered AS\nSELECT\n    revision.id,\n    revision.access_profile_id,\n    revision.default_read_history,\n    revision.default_participate,\n    revision.default_history_boundary,\n    revision.maximum_folder_capability,\n    revision.created_at,\n    (\n        SELECT count(*) FROM chat_access_profile_revisions earlier\n        WHERE earlier.access_profile_id = revision.access_profile_id\n          AND (earlier.created_at, earlier.id) <= (revision.created_at, revision.id)\n    ) AS revision\nFROM chat_access_profile_revisions revision
object	view	chat_communication_message_revisions_numbered	chat_communication_message_revisions_numbered	CREATE VIEW chat_communication_message_revisions_numbered AS\nSELECT\n    revision.id,\n    revision.message_item_id,\n    revision.normalized_markdown,\n    revision.rich_content_schema_version,\n    revision.rich_content_data,\n    revision.created_at,\n    (\n        SELECT count(*) FROM chat_communication_message_revisions earlier\n        WHERE earlier.message_item_id = revision.message_item_id\n          AND (earlier.created_at, earlier.id) <= (revision.created_at, revision.id)\n    ) AS revision\nFROM chat_communication_message_revisions revision
object	view	chat_teammate_effective_policies	chat_teammate_effective_policies	CREATE VIEW chat_teammate_effective_policies AS\nSELECT policy.*\nFROM chat_teammates teammate\nJOIN chat_teammate_policy_revisions_numbered policy\n  ON policy.id = CASE\n      WHEN EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 FROM chat_teammate_policy_revisions named\n          WHERE named.id = teammate.current_policy_revision_id\n      ) THEN (\n          SELECT named.id FROM chat_teammate_policy_revisions named\n          WHERE named.id = teammate.current_policy_revision_id\n            AND named.teammate_id = teammate.participant_id\n            AND named.safety_mode IS teammate.current_policy_safety_mode\n      )\n      ELSE (\n          SELECT newest.id FROM chat_teammate_policy_revisions newest\n          WHERE newest.teammate_id = teammate.participant_id\n          ORDER BY newest.created_at DESC, newest.id DESC\n          LIMIT 1\n      )\n  END
object	view	chat_teammate_policy_revisions_numbered	chat_teammate_policy_revisions_numbered	CREATE VIEW chat_teammate_policy_revisions_numbered AS\nSELECT\n    policy.id,\n    policy.teammate_id,\n    policy.provider_instance_id,\n    policy.model_selection_schema_version,\n    policy.model_selection_data,\n    policy.effort,\n    policy.speed,\n    policy.provider_options_schema_version,\n    policy.provider_options_data,\n    policy.interaction_mode,\n    policy.created_at,\n    policy.safety_mode,\n    (\n        SELECT count(*) FROM chat_teammate_policy_revisions earlier\n        WHERE earlier.teammate_id = policy.teammate_id\n          AND (earlier.created_at, earlier.id) <= (policy.created_at, policy.id)\n    ) AS revision\nFROM chat_teammate_policy_revisions policy
object	view	notes_relation_links	notes_relation_links	CREATE VIEW notes_relation_links AS\nSELECT\n    edge.source_page_id AS source_page_id,\n    property.data_source_id AS source_data_source_id,\n    edge.source_property_id AS source_property_id,\n    property.name AS source_property_name,\n    edge.target_page_id AS target_page_id,\n    target_page.parent_data_source_id AS target_data_source_id,\n    edge.created_time AS created_time\nFROM notes_relation_edges AS edge\nJOIN notes_pages AS source_page ON source_page.id = edge.source_page_id\nJOIN notes_pages AS target_page ON target_page.id = edge.target_page_id\nJOIN notes_data_source_properties AS property\n  ON property.data_source_id = source_page.parent_data_source_id\n AND property.property_id = edge.source_property_id\n AND property.type = 'relation'\nWHERE target_page.parent_data_source_id = json_extract(property.config, '$.relation.data_source_id')\nUNION ALL\nSELECT\n    edge.target_page_id,\n    peer.data_source_id,\n    peer.property_id,\n    peer.name,\n    edge.source_page_id,\n    property.data_source_id,\n    edge.created_time\nFROM notes_relation_edges AS edge\nJOIN notes_pages AS source_page ON source_page.id = edge.source_page_id\nJOIN notes_pages AS target_page ON target_page.id = edge.target_page_id\nJOIN notes_data_source_properties AS property\n  ON property.data_source_id = source_page.parent_data_source_id\n AND property.property_id = edge.source_property_id\n AND property.type = 'relation'\nJOIN notes_relation_pairs AS pair\n  ON pair.data_source_id = property.data_source_id\n AND pair.property_id = property.property_id\nJOIN notes_data_source_properties AS peer\n  ON peer.data_source_id = pair.peer_data_source_id\n AND peer.property_id = pair.peer_property_id\nWHERE peer.data_source_id = target_page.parent_data_source_id\n  AND NOT (peer.data_source_id = property.data_source_id\n       AND peer.property_id = property.property_id\n       AND edge.source_page_id = edge.target_page_id)
object	view	notes_relation_pairs	notes_relation_pairs	CREATE VIEW notes_relation_pairs AS\nWITH relation AS (\n    SELECT\n        data_source_id,\n        property_id,\n        json_extract(config, '$.relation.data_source_id') AS target_data_source_id,\n        json_extract(config, '$.relation.dual_property.synced_property_id') AS synced_property_id\n    FROM notes_data_source_properties\n    WHERE type = 'relation'\n),\nnaming AS (\n    SELECT\n        property.data_source_id,\n        property.property_id,\n        peer.data_source_id AS peer_data_source_id,\n        peer.property_id AS peer_property_id\n    FROM relation AS property\n    JOIN relation AS peer\n      ON peer.data_source_id = property.target_data_source_id\n     AND peer.property_id = property.synced_property_id\n     AND peer.target_data_source_id = property.data_source_id\n),\npaired AS (\n    SELECT naming.*\n    FROM naming\n    WHERE EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM naming AS back\n        WHERE back.data_source_id = naming.peer_data_source_id\n          AND back.property_id = naming.peer_property_id\n          AND back.peer_data_source_id = naming.data_source_id\n          AND back.peer_property_id = naming.property_id\n    )\n       OR (\n        NOT EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM naming AS back\n            WHERE back.data_source_id = naming.peer_data_source_id\n              AND back.property_id = naming.peer_property_id\n        )\n        AND NOT EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM naming AS other\n            WHERE other.peer_data_source_id = naming.peer_data_source_id\n              AND other.peer_property_id = naming.peer_property_id\n              AND (other.data_source_id < naming.data_source_id\n                   OR (other.data_source_id = naming.data_source_id\n                       AND other.property_id < naming.property_id))\n        )\n    )\n)\nSELECT data_source_id, property_id, peer_data_source_id, peer_property_id FROM paired\nUNION\nSELECT peer_data_source_id, peer_property_id, data_source_id, property_id FROM paired
